question: Which singer was given the Padma Shri in 2022 under the Arts category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonu Nigam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Singer, composer and actor** Sonu Nigam is from India.
 
• He received the** Padma Shri award **from the Indian government in **2022 **for his contributions to the arts.
 
• He is called the** "Modern Rafi,**" a moniker inspired by his** musical hero Muhammad Rafi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kumar Sanu:**

 
 
• The** playback singer** Kumar Sanu is from India.
 
• In Bollywood, he is referred to as the** King of Melody.**
 
• From **1990 to 1994,** he set a record by winning the **Best Male Playback Singer Filmfare Award** five times in a row.
 
• In **2009,** the Indian government honoured him with the** Padma Shri**.
 
 
 
• **Udit Narayan:**
 
 
• **Indian playback singer **Udit Narayan has primarily had songs featured in **Hindi movies.**
 
• The Indian government honoured him with the** Padma Shri in 2009 **and the **Padma Bhushan in 2016.**
 
 
 
• **Abhijeet Bhattacharya:**
 
 
• **Bollywood playback singer** Abhijeet Bhattacharya is well known.
 
• In more than** 1000 films,** Abhijeet has performed **6034 songs.**
 
• The** Uttar Pradesh Gaurav Samman** was given to him.
